rows.en: <operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>We spent these past two years investigating every colony out there, didn't we?
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>So why couldn't we tell <color(5)>Char<ce()> was preparing his forces?
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>The <color(4)>Earth Federation<ce()> government rules space from Earth, but there are plenty of Spacenoids who hate that.
rows.notes: 'chihou renpou seifu' rendered with the tag on the locked term only, 'government' plain, per encyclopedia convention.

rows.en: <operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>If <color(4)>Londo Bell<ce()> goes to investigate, ordinary people end up shielding him.
rows.notes: Object of 'guard' omitted in source; context (Char) supplies 'him'.

rows.en: <operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>How pathetic. At this rate, all we're doing is watching <color(5)>Char<ce()> get the upper hand.
rows.notes: 'yarareru' (get done in by Char) has no explicit victim; kept impersonal ('get the upper hand') rather than inventing 'us'.

rows.en: <operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>So we have to be the ones to stop him.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah...
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Faye<ce()>. <color(5)>Berkt<ce()>... is he really over here?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>I can't say for sure. But all we can do is trust our own choice.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>He's out there trying to pull off something outrageous... and here we are doing this. Is that really okay?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>We have to keep our eyes on the crisis in front of us too.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>...I know that.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>Still, you've gotten a lot more positive.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... I still hate it, but given the situation, well.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>I've been thinking about this since we got back here... Do you still feel like leaving?
rows.notes: 'oritai' = wanting to get off/leave (the ship/piloting); matches 'leave the ship' convention from 4004463.

rows.en: <operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Huh? Why bring that up now, of all times?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>We finally made it back to the surface, and once the fighting's over, it'll be safe here too.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>That's... I've been thinking about it too, since we got back.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>But leaving's no sure bet for safety, and plenty of people are giving it their all. ...I can't walk away now.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>If there's something I can do... I want to give it a try.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>...Thank you. Hearing you say that honestly puts me at ease.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>You seemed shaky at first, but I trust you now. So keep it up.
<operator(1040,2)><speed(2)>Yeah. Thanks.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>We still don't know <color(5)>Char Aznable<ce()>'s intentions, but I doubt a plan like this would satisfy him.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>I know. I'll make it clear soon enough.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>That <color(5)>Meio<ce()> guy... why would he do something like that?!
rows.notes: 'Maiyo' short name = Meio Plato per character_names_021.json.

rows.en: <operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Well, I guess he simply got fed up with everything.
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>But why would a man who fought for Earth become its enemy again?
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>He's not fighting Earth. He's trying to fight the <color(4)>Federation<ce()>.
rows.notes: Bare 'renpou' rendered 'Federation' with no article, matching 4004463's usage; ambiguous which Federation, left as source leaves it.

rows.en: <operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Can people really stake their lives for beliefs or principles like that?
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>It's precisely because of belief and principle that people stake their lives.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>But if you die, doesn't that make it all meaningless?!
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>There's meaning and worth in it that goes beyond death. You'll understand that yourselves, in time.
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>No matter where we go, what people get up to doesn't change much, huh.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>That's exactly why... we're the ones who've got to do something about it.
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>There you go acting cool again, all because <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>'s around.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>S-shut up!
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Hey, <color(4)>Renton<ce()>, what's wrong?
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Ah, um, well, how do I put this. Uhhhhh...
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Huh?!
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)>Is it because this is a different world? Are you still confused?
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Y-yeah, that's it! That's it!
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>If you're gonna say something that soft, get out of there right now.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Y-yes!... Sc-scary...
<operator(23020,2)><speed(2)>You'll be fine, <color(4)>Renton<ce()>.
<operator(23010,2)><speed(2)>Th-thanks, <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>!
<operator(21020,2)><speed(2)>Well now, this is getting interesting.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>This isn't interesting at all! Not one bit!
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>Listen, <color(4)>Gainer<ce()>. Keep that attitude up and I worry about what's ahead for you.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Ahead or not, I'm only the one getting dragged into all this!
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>Sheesh...
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>Was it really all right to leave <color(5)>Shin Dragon<ce()> behind and stay on this side?
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Go<ce()>... aren't you worried, <color(4)>Go<ce()>?
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>I'm fine...
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>There'll be a chance to meet <color(5)>Shin Dragon<ce()> again. I'm sure of it...

uncertainties.issue: 'chikyuu renpou seifu' rendered 'the Earth Federation government' with the tag on 'Earth Federation' only, matching how encyclopedia_022 splits the same compound; this is the classic UC Earth Federation, not the ACE-original New Federation.
'gaado shite shimau' has no stated object; 'him' (Char) supplied from the surrounding two lines.
'Char ni yarareru' has no stated victim; rendered impersonally ('get the upper hand') instead of inventing 'us'.

Bare 'renpou' (no 'New' or 'Earth' prefix) rendered plain 'Federation', matching the one other bare use in the reviewed corpus (4004463); could be read as either the classic Earth Federation (Dragonar/Meio's continuity) or the ACE-original New Federation - left open as in the source.

meaning_fixes.reason: Source is a bare 'hai' with no honorific or address term; 'sir' was invented and not supported by the Japanese.

checked_decisions: 0/21 'the Earth Federation government' for 'chikyuu renpou seifu' - orchestrator ruling confirms this is correct; kept.
1/102 bare 'renpou' rendered plain 'Federation' - orchestrator ruling confirms this is correct; kept, ambiguity left as in source.
0/19-39, 1/19-20, 1/59-262: compared every row against the Japanese source line by line; all match in meaning, subject/addressee, and tag order.
0/22 'him' (Char) supplied for the omitted object of 'gaado shite shimau': settled by the surrounding two lines about Char; accepted.

0/23 'Char ni yarareru' (no stated victim) rendered impersonally as 'watching Char get the upper hand': preserves the real-world meaning (the speaker's side losing to Char) without inventing 'us'; accepted.
Speaker tags taken as given per orchestrator instruction, not altered even where cross-checked against character_names_021.json/speaker_lookup.py.
Names checked against glossary: Char, Londo Bell, Faye, Berkt, Meio Plato, Char Aznable, Tiffa Adill, Renton Thurston, Eureka, Gainer Sanga, Go, Shin Dragon - all match.
remaining_uncertainties: 0/21: whether 'the Earth Federation government' ruling extends to every future bare use of 'renpou seifu' in later scenes is outside this scene's scope; flagging for consistency tracking only.
0/22: object 'him' for the omitted guard-target is an inference from context, not stated in the source; left as in the draft.
0/23: impersonal 'get the upper hand' for 'yarareru' is a legitimate but non-literal rendering; left as in the draft.
1/102: bare 'Federation' is genuinely ambiguous between the classic Earth Federation and the ACE-original New Federation; left open as the source leaves it, per orchestrator ruling.
